tool.name: Edit Agent
tool.description: Update an existing agent by slug with partial fields (name, role, description, model, systemPrompt, temperature, maxTokens, blueprint, timeout, previewPrompts). Returns a lean agent summary (no blueprint/state).

role.description: New agent role (separate field from systemPrompt). If you change role, consider updating the systemPrompt identity/header to match.

systemPrompt.description: New system instructions. Must begin with <character name="AGENT_NAME">ROLE</character> as the first line and preserve this header unless explicitly changing name/role.

nodes.name: Prepare Update Request
nodes.description: Build URL, headers and partial body for agent update

nodes.name: Prepare Update Request
nodes.description: Extract agent ID and prepare PUT request

nodes.name: Unwrap
nodes.description: Return body.data/body.error where applicable; otherwise return body/resp

nodes.name: Slim Agent
nodes.description: Return a lean agent summary (omit blueprint/state and internal metadata)
